entries.mc_cluster_tool.aim_paste_hint: Aim at a structure and press G to place it back onto the grid
entries.mc_cluster_tool.crate_no_flood: Crate mode only supports box selection
entries.mc_cluster_tool.help: Structure grabber: left click selects blocks (R toggles box select), E flood selects, G converts the selection into an entity; aim at an entity and press G to place it back onto the grid.
entries.mc_cluster_tool.instructions: Left selects  Right deselects  R toggles mode  E flood select  G convert/place back  X clear
entries.mc_cluster_tool.mode_crate: Switched to crate mode (single-box collision, for large structures)
entries.mc_cluster_tool.name: MC Structure Grabber
entries.mc_cluster_tool.purpose: Turn selected Minecraft blocks into a movable physics entity
entries.mc_cluster_tool.ui_paste_tilted: Level it with the physgun first
entries.mc_creative_placer.hud: Left breaks    Right places    Middle picks (auto)    Shift+Middle copies state    Reload opens inventory    Tab switches weapon
entries.mc_creative_placer.instructions: Left click breaks  Right click places  Reload opens creative inventory
entries.mc_creative_placer.name: MC DEBUG TOOL
entries.mc_creative_placer.purpose: Place and break Minecraft blocks, with a creative inventory picker
entries.mc_preset_placer.help: Preset placer: press R to open the manager. Create presets with four left-click steps; after loading one, left click places it.
entries.mc_preset_placer.instructions: R opens presets  Left click selects/places  Right click undoes  G rotates
entries.mc_preset_placer.name: MC Preset Placer
entries.mc_preset_placer.place_hint: Left click places projection   Right click cancels   E overwrite   G rotate   R presets
entries.mc_preset_placer.purpose: Save and place Minecraft block build presets
entries.mc_preset_placer.step0: Left click selects first block   Right click cancels
entries.mc_preset_placer.step1: Left click selects second block to finish range   Right click undoes
entries.mc_preset_placer.step2: Left click selects anchor face   Right click undoes
entries.mc_preset_placer.step3: Left click captures and saves   Right click undoes
entries.mc_preset_placer.title: MC Preset Placer
